news.title: NTR Confirms Full Recovery from Shoulder Surgery and Prepares for Dragon
news.summary: Jr NTR announced that he has fully recovered from his shoulder injury and subsequent surgery after attending a recent promotional event. news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's Big-Budget Venture Raaka Eyeing Two-Part Release
news.summary: Allu Arjun is completely immersed in the high-budget international-standard project Raaka, directed by Atlee and produced by Sun Pictures. The film features a massive ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, Mrunal Thakur, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lekshmi. news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Pressure As Streaming Platforms Cut Acquisition Budgets
news.summary: Telugu cinema producers are encountering severe financial challenges as digital streaming platforms scale back acquisition budgets and tie deals to box-office results. With OTT players refusing inflated pricing models, big-budget and medium-range projects face significant recovery risks. This shift is expected to compel filmmakers to prioritize controlled budgets and theatrical performance over streaming safety nets.
